tools.name: get_puzzle
tools.description: A fresh Routepot puzzle, played once: its id, token graph, start and target tokens, the house baseline, the commitment to its draw and the rules in force with any change announced ahead. Free.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: A play's outcome, the best route, and the secret whose sha256 is the commitment, so the draw can be checked. Free.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: What the Routepot game owes a wallet in winnings and refunds, and what it has paid it. Free.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Play a Routepot puzzle ($0.10) with a route from its start to its target token and learn at once whether it won a multiple of the entry. The better the route, the better the odds; each puzzle's rules give the multiples, odds and rake in force.

tools.name: send_usdc
tools.description: Send USDC on Base to any address with no gas: the x402 payment itself is the transfer, paid straight to the recipient you choose. 0.01 to 1.00 USDC per send.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_result" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
